title: plectranthus dupuisii
intro: Plectranthus dupuisii, commonly known as Vicks plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relieving respiratory issues, reducing fever, and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of Plectranthus dupuisii include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health concerns. The plant's bioactive constituents include camphor, borneol, and bornyl acetate, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
